Gomoku

Gomoku on a 15×15 board — get five stones in a row before the computer or a friend does.

0
Black wins
0
White wins
0
Draws

📖 How to use

  1. Pick “Vs computer” (choose your color) or “Two players”.
  2. Click any empty intersection to place your stone.
  3. Get five of your stones in a row — horizontal, vertical or diagonal.
  4. The AI answers after a short think; the winning five are highlighted.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the computer play?

The computer scores every empty square by the threats it creates for both sides — it takes an immediate win, blocks your open fours and threes, and otherwise builds its strongest line.

Who moves first?

You do. Black always moves first, which is a real advantage in Gomoku — that's why the computer takes black when you choose white.

Can the game end in a draw?

Stones can never be moved or captured in Gomoku, so draws are rare but possible if the whole 15×15 board fills up.
